title: SCT-Tech Enablement-Digital supply chain lead-FDE-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**SCT\-Tech Enablement \- Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front\-end and back\-end layers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy full\-stack web applications using modern front\-end and back\-end technologies.
* Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Develop robust server\-side applications, APIs, and microservices using technologies such as Node.js, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Design and optimize relational and non\-relational databases to ensure performance, scalability, and data integrity.
* Integrate applications with internal and external systems through RESTful APIs and event\-driven architectures.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design sessions to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring practices across the application landscape.
* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud\-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge\-sharing across teams.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 6–10 years of hands\-on experience in full\-stack application development.
* Strong proficiency in front\-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js and Microsoft 365 technologies like PowerApps.
* Experience in back\-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event\-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test\-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Salesforce B2B Commerce Lead
description:
**Job Title \- Salesforce B2B Commerce Lead – Specialist – ACS Song**
**Management Level: Level 9 \- Specialist**
**Location: Kochi**
**Must have skills: Salesforce Generic**
**Good to have skills: Salesforce B2B Commerce**
**Experience: 5–8 years of experience in Salesforce B2B Commerce and related technologies**
**Educational Qualification: Graduation (accurate educational details should be captured)**
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced and motivated Salesforce B2B Commerce Lead – Specialist with 5–8 years of experience in designing, developing, and delivering scalable eCommerce solutions on Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud. The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce platform capabilities, with proven experience in both backend and frontend development. You will lead technical delivery, mentor team members, and ensure adherence to best practices while collaborating with cross\-functional teams to drive successful multi\-market rollouts.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Own the technical direction and ensure delivery of high\-quality, scalable, and maintainable Salesforce B2B Commerce solutions.
* Lead and mentor developers, providing guidance through code reviews, technical planning, and solution design.
* Design, develop, debug, unit test, and document complex Salesforce applications and integrations.
* Develop and customize Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Communities for B2B Commerce Cloud.
* Implement Apex Classes, Triggers (before/after insert, update, delete), and Scheduler Classes for automation.
* Create and manage Flows (Schedule\-triggered, AutoLaunched, Record\-triggered) and modify standard checkout flows.
* Make architectural and design decisions ensuring scalability, maintainability, and compliance with Salesforce standards.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align technical implementation with business requirements.
* Proactively identify technical risks and propose improvements across the codebase and processes.
* Ensure proper validation checks, error handling, and user experience enhancements (e.g., Toast Notifications).
* Act as a key troubleshooter in complex/escalated incidents and provide innovative solutions.
* Manage multi\-market rollouts including multi\-currency and multi\-language implementations.
* Ensure adherence to CI/CD pipelines, code quality standards, and Salesforce best practices.

description:

To learn more, please visit our website: https://innspark.in.** 




  





**﻿Front\-End Developer (Angular) — Innspark** 




**📍 Kollam · 🏢 On\-site · 🕒 Full\-time · 👤 2–3 years experience** 




  





**Are you an Angular developer with a sharp eye for detail and a passion for building polished, well\-tested user interfaces? At InnSpark, we'd love to talk to you.** 




  





**What you'll do** 




**\- Build responsive, accessible UI components with Angular (v15\+) and TypeScript** 




**\- Write and maintain UI automation tests with Playwright (our preferred tool)** 




**\- Write unit tests for components and services (Jasmine/Karma or Jest)** 




**\- Turn Figma/Sketch designs into pixel\-precise, faithful UI** 




**\- Consume REST/GraphQL APIs and manage state cleanly (RxJS, signals, NgRx)** 




**\- Collaborate within Agile/SCRUM ceremonies and contribute to code reviews** 




  





**What you bring** 




**\- 2–3 years hands\-on Angular (TypeScript, components, services, RxJS)** 




**\- Strong HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+)** 




**\- UI automation testing — Playwright preferred (Cypress a plus)** 




**\- Proficiency with Git and conventional commits** 




**\- Experience in Agile/SCRUM teams and CI/CD pipelines** 




**\- Solid grasp of responsive design, cross\-browser behavior, and accessibility (WCAG)** 




**\- Exceptional attention to detail — visual precision and consistency** 




  





**Nice to have** 




**\- State management (NgRx, NGXS, Angular signals)** 




**\- Component libraries (Angular Material, PrimeNG) \& design systems** 




**\- Performance profiling, lazy loading, bundle optimization** 




**\- Code\-coverage gates and automated test reporting in CI** 




  





**What we value** 




**A craftsperson's eye, a quality\-first mindset, and pride in shipping interfaces that are correct, accessible, and maintainable.** 




  





**💡 Don't have every skill on this list? We'd still love to hear from you. If you're passionate about front\-end craft and eager to learn, please apply — the right attitude and willingness to grow matter just as much to us as ticking every box.**

description:
About the Role
 



 We are seeking a detail\-oriented Test Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality of our products by meeting specific testing metrics and quality objectives. Success in this position will be measured by reduction in production defects, testing efficiency, and ability to maintain high\-quality standards throughout the development lifecycle.
 



 Key Performance Indicators
 


* Achieve 95%\+ test coverage for all new features and major updates
* Reduce escaped defects (bugs found in production) by at least 20% within 6 months
* Maintain a defect closure rate of at least 90% for each sprint
* Complete 100% of assigned test cases within sprint timeframes
* Contribute to reducing overall QA cycle time by 15% through process improvements



 Responsibilities
 


* Design, develop, and execute 20\+ comprehensive test plans per quarter, ensuring 90%\+ test coverage
* Create and maintain at least 50 automated test scripts each quarter, with 98% reliability rate
* Identify and log 90% of critical defects before code reaches staging environments
* Reduce average defect resolution time from 72 hours to 48 hours through clear documentation
* Conduct 10\+ cross\-browser/device compatibility tests per release
* Complete performance testing for all new features, ensuring they meet defined performance benchmarks
* Decrease regression testing time by 20% through optimized test suites and automation
* Participate in 100% of sprint planning and review meetings, providing QA perspective
* Submit weekly metrics reports covering test execution status, defect trends, and quality risks
* Mentor 1\-2 junior QA team members per year



 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent work experience)
* 3\+ years of experience in software testing with demonstrable metrics of success
* Proven track record of reducing production defects by at least 15% year over year
* Experience managing 500\+ test cases within test management systems
* Demonstrated ability to automate at least 60% of regression test suites
* Proficiency in at least one testing framework with ability to create 30\+ reliable test scripts per month
* Experience with performance testing, consistently identifying 85% of performance bottlenecks before production
* History of maintaining 95%\+ accuracy in defect reporting and documentation



 Technical Skills
 


* Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript) with ability to write 200\+ lines of clean test code daily
* Experience with test management tools, managing 300\+ test cases simultaneously
* Demonstrated ability to create automated test frameworks that reduce manual testing by 40%
* Knowledge of SQL with ability to validate data integrity across 10\+ database tables
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, reducing build verification time by 25%

title: Associate Architect
description:
**Lead Engineer/Associate Architect – .NET Full Stack** 




  





**Experience:** 
 8–10 yrs
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Office, Hybrid
 



  





 Location:
 **Kochi** 




  





**Job Description** 




 We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to take technical ownership of the systems and interfaces powering our data platform — from database design and back\-end APIs to front\-end applications and dashboards. The role combines hands\-on development with technical leadership: setting engineering standards, guiding architecture, and mentoring engineers, while owning solutions end\-to\-end from requirements through production.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the design, development and production support of full\-stack solutions across front\-end, back\-end and database layers.
* Build front\-end applications (Vue, React, Blazor or similar) and back\-end APIs/services (preferably C\#/.NET).
* Design and evolve PostgreSQL database solutions — schemas, indexing, query performance and migrations.
* Guide architectural decisions; set and uphold standards for code quality, testing and technical design.
* Conduct code reviews and mentor engineers to build team technical capability.
* Build comprehensive automated test coverage (unit, integration, end\-to\-end) across the SDLC.
* Design and support RESTful/event\-driven APIs and distributed system integrations.
* Monitor production systems using observability/logging/alerting tools; lead incident response and root\-cause analysis.
* Collaborate with engineering and product stakeholders, clearly communicating technical trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.



  





**Key Requirements** 



* Senior/lead\-level full\-stack engineering experience, with proven front\-end work in Vue, React, Blazor or similar.
* Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS and front\-end performance/architecture skills.
* Solid back\-end experience, preferably C\#/.NET, building RESTful and/or event\-driven services.
* Strong PostgreSQL experience — schema design, query optimisation, indexing and production migrations.
* Proven ability to ship features end\-to\-end, from requirements to production.
* Hands\-on experience with unit/integration/E2E testing and driving engineering quality practices.
* Experience influencing architecture, leading code reviews, and mentoring engineers.
* Experience with data\-intensive/high\-volume systems and production operations (DevOps mindset, monitoring, observability, incident response).
* Strong analytical and communication skills, with sound technical judgement and ownership mindset.
